name: Mixed-owner toll and escape-pod state survives game-server restart

tests.name: Reauthenticate payer after serving process restart
Reauthenticate destroyed-ship owner after serving process restart
Verify mixed-owner payment and refusal outcomes persisted through restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer')=996 AND (SELECT sector_id FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer')=20 AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_a')=1000000002 AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_b')=1000000002 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM toll_passage_offers WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer') AND state='accepted' AND amount=4)=1 AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser')=1000 AND (SELECT state FROM toll_passage_offers WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser') AND state='refused')='refused' AND (SELECT st.name FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE p.name='mixed_toll_refuser')='Escape Pod' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
